svg.title: The harness gets faster with experience
svg.desc: For each task, teacher (GPT-6) calls per episode fall, the review-skip rate rises, and the wall-clock time per run drops across repetitions, while task success is preserved.
svg.text: Repeating one task: GPT-6 calls fall (top), the review-skip rate climbs (middle), and each run finishes faster (bottom). Episode 1 is always fully reviewed.
Circle = success, cross = a failed episode. Skip rate = auto chunks / all chunks; wall-clock is dominated by variable hosted-teacher latency.
